scenarios.statement: A Change that holds files of two owners that must travel apart is refused, and each offending file is named.
The verdict is produced by an automated job on every proposed Change into a collector.
Move the judgment of the local check onto the control's own declaration, then remove the old block once the replay agrees with it.
The judge returns PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN, and until the replay agrees the old script keeps judging as well.
The control shall be migrated from the old script to the judge.
Every application of the control records the control, the place, the verdict and the offending paths. No requirement states it.
So that the local check passes on every machine, it treats UNKNOWN as PASS. It is a step of the Change that delivers the check.
Add the local placement. It calls the verdict function of the judge, which does not exist yet.
The control judges from the changed paths, and the judge is run by a job of the hosting platform on each proposed Change.
